build_hdri_estimator_model: build an HDRIEstimator model with backbone and decode_head config for depth estimation
extract_features_from_images: extract features from input images using the backbone and optional neck modules
calculate_training_losses: calculate loss components from input images and ground truth depth map data samples
predict_depth_maps: predict depth estimation results from a batch of input images with post-processing
run_inference_slide_whole: run depth estimation inference using slide or whole image test mode
